verdict.rationale: Bugbot is documented to run unattended in the background on every new PR and PR update. It can also be triggered by a PR comment (`bugbot run`), which users can script; one community user does this from a GitHub Action. That is headless, event-driven automation, but there is no documented CLI, API, or CI pipeline step that would let it run as part of a user's own CI jobs. missing for 10: documented CLI/API or CI step for running Bugbot in a pipeline, machine-readable output or exit codes for gating builds, first-party docs on scripted triggering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: When enabled, Bugbot automatically runs AI code review in the background on new PRs.
Runs automatic reviews on every PR update
Manual trigger by commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run` on any PR
They now trigger them on request via a GitHub Action
